title: Post-Up Drop-Step Finish
description: A post player seals for position on the block, then drop-steps baseline or middle depending on where the defender overplays, finishing strong at the rim.

content.objective: Read which side the defender overplays and drop-step to the open side for an easy finish.
content.setup: A post player seals on the block as a defender plays either high-side or low-side.
instructions: Catch the ball with a strong, wide base and seal the defender's position.
Feel which side the defender is leaning and drop-step to the opposite, open side.
Finish strong with two hands, keeping the ball above the shoulders.
Reset with the defender switching sides every few reps.
coachingPoints: Feel for the defender's position rather than looking back at them.
Keep the drop-step tight and low for balance.
Finish with authority once the lane opens.
commonMistakes: Drop-stepping into the defender instead of away from them.
Catching with a narrow base that's easy to push off balance.
Finishing off the wrong foot for the angle of approach.
content.safety: Defender holds position without grabbing or hooking the post player's arm.
